subject: Request: KMS/HSM forensics + retention checklist for SIG/SOC2 review
messages:
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@praxisfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@praxisfin.com>, security-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: KMS/HSM artifacts for upcoming SIG + SOC2 sampling

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of our SIG and SOC2 evidence intake, our security team needs a compact package showing the following for the tenant scope we discussed (Praxis production tenant):

- A manifest of active customer KEKs/DEKs and the key IDs in your KMS/HSM ledger (creation timestamps + current wrapping algorithm)
- Rotation and rewrap event logs for Oct 1 — Nov 1 2028 (key IDs, event type, actor, and outcome)
- Evidence of secure key destruction/retirement where applicable (signed operator records)
- TLS in-transit encryption summary (cipher suites, termination points, and any L7 proxy re-encryption)
- KMS/HSM operator access matrix and recent shift logs for Nov 2028

Can you provide a single delivery (PDF manifest + raw logs) and a short description of how you correlate an application-level token to a KEK/DEK for audit traceability? Our intake deadline for the sampling window is EOD Fri, 1 Dec.

Appreciate it — Elena
Elena Santos
Senior Security Systems Analyst
Praxis Financial

---
Note: please keep any sensitive raw key material out of the package. We only need metadata and signed operator traces.
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@praxisfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts for upcoming SIG + SOC2 sampling

Elena — thanks for the clear checklist. We can deliver that scope. Quick notes and ask up front:

- We will produce a PDF manifest that maps key IDs to tenant aliases, creation and last-rotation timestamps, wrapping algorithm, and the model of HSM used (vendor + module id).
- Raw logs (rotation_event_log_20281001-20281101.csv) will include event_type (create/rotate/rewrap/retire), actor (operator id or automated), request_id, and outcome. Sensitive ciphertext or key material will be redacted.
- For destruction proof, we will include operator-signed shift logs and the HSM-logged zeroize confirmation (attestation stub), not the unencrypted key exports.
- TLS summary: we publish our edge and internal proxy cipher inventory; note that customer traffic to Praxis region terminates at our load balancer and is TLS 1.3 with AES-GCM/CHACHA options.

Marissa — can you pull the October rotation window CSV and the November shift logs and add the operator-signed retirement entries? Irene — can you produce the manifest PDF and the short audit narrative that explains token->KEK mapping (2 paragraphs)?

Elena — can you confirm whether the intake wants operator email signatures or PGP-signed shift logs? We have both available; PGP-signed is preferred for chain-of-custody.

Target: deliver draft package by Wed 29 Nov COB so Praxis can review ahead of the Friday intake. If you need a later window we can request extension but need to know today.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts for upcoming SIG + SOC2 sampling

Logan — pulling the logs now. A few operational clarifications for the package:

- rotation_event_log_20281001-20281101.csv will include fields: event_ts, key_id, event_type, actor_id, operator_signature_present (true/false), request_id, hsm_module_id, note
- hsm-operator-shiftlog-20281120.txt will be an excerpt of the operator shift notes that contains the retire/zeroize entries and the shift manager signature. We'll include PGP sig blocks where available.
- For token-to-key correlation: we will include a short snippet of our audit query used to join application token_id to DEK id in our telemetry DB (no secrets). Irene will craft the narrative and add the final phrasing for auditors.

ETA: I can hand the CSV + shift log to Logan and Irene by 16:00 PST today. Will redact operator personal email addresses and leave operator IDs as opaque handles (op-###) unless Praxis needs the mapping (requires a data-sharing agreement).

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Crypto Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment placeholders: rotation_event_log_20281001-20281101.csv (csv, 132KB); hsm-operator-shiftlog-20281120.txt (txt, 18KB)
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@praxisfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@praxisfin.com>, security-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM artifacts for upcoming SIG + SOC2 sampling

Logan / Marissa — this timeline works for us. A few follow-ups:

1) PGP-signed shift logs are ideal — please include them. If operator IDs are pseudonymized, include the mapping under a separate DSA (we will request that today).
2) For the destruction evidence: we only need the HSM zeroize attestation entries and the operator signatures — do not include any HSM-protected key material, per your note.
3) Please include the short token->KEK correlation narrative (two paragraphs) and, if possible, an example request_id that is anonymized so our auditors can validate the join logic.

If you can send the draft package to security-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com and me by Wed COB we will ingest and confirm whether we require any follow-up. Thanks for moving quickly.

Best,
Elena

---
